name: Region segmenter
description: Outlines regions of each class (tumour, stroma, necrosis), learned from polygons and brushed areas. Everything not drawn counts as background, so annotate the patches you train on completely.

choices.label: Small (LR-ASPP MobileNet) - fast, fits a 4 GB graphics card
Large (DeepLabV3 ResNet-50) - more accurate, needs 8 GB or more

settings.label: Epochs
settings.help: How many times the model sees every training image.

settings.label: Image size (px)
settings.help: Patches are resized to a square of this size. Larger follows outlines more closely but needs more memory.

settings.label: Batch size
settings.help: Images per step. Lower it if the run fails with 'out of memory'.
